observations: Photo 0 shows a bare engine assembly removed from a vehicle, resting on a concrete/paved surface outdoors.
Wiring harness, intake manifold, and various hoses/connectors are visible and appear intact.
A watermark reading 'TI AUTOMOBILE' is overlaid on the image.
No engine code, manufacturer plate, VIN sticker, or model badge is legible anywhere in the photo.
No visible fluid leaks, cracks, or corrosion, but the engine is not running and no internal parts are shown.
Seller's new message is text only, reaffirming prior claims verbally; no new photo or video was provided.

claims.claim: Direct tokumbo engine, Tokunbo, direct from Belgium
claims.evidence: No shipping documents, customs papers, or country-of-origin marking visible in photo 0; seller's repeated assurance is words only.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock (reaffirmed: 'I tested it myself yesterday')
claims.evidence: Still no start-up video or sound clip provided; a verbal claim does not substitute for visual/audio proof.
No odometer, ECU readout, or documentation shown.
No close-up of bolt seals, gasket surfaces, or casing screws to confirm it hasn't been disassembled.

risks.risk: Unknown make/model/engine code means price range cannot even be bounded (could be a small 4-cylinder or a larger V6/diesel, vastly different values).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine ID plate/sticker or the engine code stamped on the block.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all; identity-dependent

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition (compression, bearings, timing chain/belt wear) cannot be seen.
risks.proof: Video of the engine running/idling with audible sound, plus a compression test reading.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, i.e. worst case (non-running/needs repair)

risks.risk: Mileage claim cannot be checked remotely.
risks.proof: Photo of odometer or ECU mileage readout from the donor vehicle before removal.

risks.risk: Import origin claim ('Belgium') affects buyer trust/duty assumptions but is unverifiable from a photo.
risks.proof: Photo of shipping manifest, bill of lading, or customs clearance paper.
risks.if_unproven: ignored for pricing purposes, treated as unverified origin

risks.risk: Missing accessories (turbo, sensors, alternator, starter) could be incomplete, affecting value.
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photo set of the engine including front, rear, and underside.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare long block only, missing ancillaries

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine ID plate, engine code, or casting number.
Video of the engine running/idling with sound.
Photo of odometer or mileage readout from source vehicle.
Additional photos from front, rear, and underside showing all ancillaries present.
Any import/customs documentation if origin claim is to be relied upon.
response.reason: A verbal reassurance adds no new visual evidence; the engine's identity and working condition still cannot be confirmed from the single photo, so no price, even worst-case, can be set without further proof.
